definition: Oracle Application Framework is a Java-based framework for building web interfaces and business applications in Oracle E-Business Suite.
entry_text: Oracle Application Framework is a Java-based framework for building web interfaces and business applications in Oracle E-Business Suite.
example: A developer extends a self-service page while retaining the application's navigation and data model.
label: Oracle Application Framework
sense_note: Often identified as OA Framework; distinguish from Oracle Application Development Framework.
